lessons.text: Run a robustness check of the target's definition beside the first mechanism question; a late check cannot redirect questions that already ran.
lessons.applies_when: the target of the question depends on a baseline, region or period choice

lessons.text: Bound an unclosed residual with a second, independent estimator before attributing it; one estimator cannot show how much of the residual is its own error.
lessons.applies_when: a budget residual carries the conclusion

lessons.text: A lesson the meta-agent retired stays in the file and reaches no reader.
